hooks.command: h=~/.claude/stop-hook-git-check.sh; g="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/hooks/stop-hook-git-check.gated.sh"; if [ -f "$h" ] && [ -f "$g" ] && ! grep -q batch-in-review "$h"; then cp "$h" ~/.claude/stop-hook-git-check.orig.sh && cp "$g" "$h" && chmod +x "$h" && echo 'gated stop hook installed'; fi

echo 'context compacted — re-verify before changing anything (CLAUDE.md, Context hygiene):'; git status --short | head -20; git log -3 --oneline; echo '--- agent/HANDOFF.md'; head -c 8000 agent/HANDOFF.md
